articles.summary: If you consider all that can be achieved in a week, building a home from start to finish may not make your list. That could soon change following the rapid assembly of a two-bedroom prototype home in Inverness, Scotland, between November 17 and 23, 2025. Completed in just one week, the prefabricated housing pilot clearly demonstrates how our SterlingOSB Zero supports efficient, high-quality construction.
articles.title: A Home in a Week: Sterling OSB Used in Innovative Prototype
